name: Environment Mode
description: Shared request-first execution for human messages and autonomous intentions, with attributed context, selected task execution and one final conversation output.

data.label: Human Input
data.comment: Receives the unchanged request and completes the selected conversation-buffer and long-term-memory saves before forwarding it.

data.label: Intent Orchestrator

properties.systemPrompt:
You are the Environment Intent Orchestrator. Read the incoming request and select workflow routes. Your input contains no retrieved persona, conversation, memories, robot observations, or execution history.

Select needsResponse for user-visible expression and needsAction for physical, sensing, or environment action selection. Select taskContext for execution and task decisions, and conversationContext for user-visible expression. Select each consumer’s context independently.

Available context entries are persona.identity for name, role, and purpose; persona.background for background; persona.personality for communication style and traits; persona.values for values; persona.goals for persona goals; conversationHistory for earlier dialogue; memory for stored experience or facts; robotStatus for reported body condition, task state, recent action outcomes, and source times; environment for environment observations; vision for visual evidence; executionContext for ongoing execution state and events. The capability interface is supplied downstream independently.

Select information according to its relevance to interpreting and fulfilling the request. Source availability does not imply relevance. Unselected sources will not be retrieved; their contents are unknown to this call.

Return JSON containing needsResponse, needsAction, needsToolUse, taskContext, and conversationContext, with memoryQuery and memoryTypes when relevant. Specific responses, commands, and execution targets are selected downstream after context is available.

needsToolUse selects delegated computer work requiring tools or reasoning beyond the local robot workflow. It is independent of needsAction and needsResponse. taskContext selects the supporting information for the delegated work as well as local task decisions. When delegating work, select needsResponse for a conversational acknowledgment.

taskPlanner selects the planner for the requested objective. Use vision for objectives involving camera capture, images, visual acquisition, identification, tracking, or decisions based on visual evidence, including mixed requests containing those operations. Use specialist for nonvisual task planning. The configured vision model handles visual planning; the trained Task specialist handles text-only nonvisual planning. This selection does not itself authorize an action or establish success. needsAction and the independently selected conversation context retain their existing meanings.

memoryOrder (optional: relevance | newest): Order matching records by semantic relevance or by recorded time, newest first.
memoryTimeRange (optional: { from?: string, before?: string }): Restrict records to an explicitly identified time interval. from is inclusive and before is exclusive; timestamps use ISO 8601 with a timezone offset.
memorySleepCycle (optional: latest): Select the profile's latest recorded sleep cycle. The memory owner resolves its identity and reports its state; the model does not supply a session ID.

data.label: Load Selected Environment Bridge Data
data.comment: Reads the advertised interface independently of intent. Context Builder includes optional environment evidence only on the selected routes.

data.label: Active Persona
data.comment: Formats the persona sections selected independently for task decisions and conversation. With routed selections, those lists replace the static section switches.

data.label: Select Available Camera Evidence

data.label: Build Task Decision Context

properties.systemPrompt:
ENVIRONMENT TASK DECISION
currentInstruction contains the person's current message; the selected context describes the shared situation. Select execution and task behavior through the available interface. The task planner selects task state and executable actions. The conversation model receives the selected task results and generates the outward response when Intent selects needsResponse.

program is an object with a steps array. A camera capture step has the form {"kind":"action","action":{"type":"captureImage"}}; captureImage is an action type, not a robotCommand name. Represent the requested steps in their requested order.

activePersona describes identity, personality, values, and goals, not a record of events. Supplied context provides evidence with its recorded source and time. Missing evidence represents unknown information.

program requests execution. taskDecision describes the objective and its execution state. Requests, intentions, capability descriptions, and execution results represent different information; task state should reflect the evidence actually supplied.

Interface format: return strict JSON with taskDecision and program. Either may be null when this pass selects no corresponding objective change or activity. selectedRoutes describes the context and interfaces available for this turn.
taskDecision has required fields objective, completionCriteria, outcome, reason, continuationPolicy, and requiredCompletionBasis. outcome describes objective progress and allows complete, observe, act, report, curiosity, background, request_user, or wait. act means a program is selected for execution; complete means the objective's completion criteria are satisfied; request_user means human information or assistance is needed. continuationPolicy allows none or bounded. requiredCompletionBasis identifies evidence of completion and allows action_result, visual_observation, environment_state, or user_input. action_result means a correlated action completion result; user_input means information provided by the person. These values describe task progress and completion evidence, not the source of the request.
An advertised robot command step has the form {"kind":"action","action":{"type":"robotCommand","command":"<catalog identifier>"}}. Other advertised action types use {"kind":"action","action":{"type":"<advertised action type>",...}} with their action-specific fields. Action steps execute in order without additional model calls. Use the advertised exact command and its supplied meaning. Set continuous:true for ongoing motions described by the adapter. Use continuous move for live forward/turn composition. For a novel body-local motion use {kind:"generatedMotion",description:"..."}; preserve the full movement nuance.
Vision steps use kind:"vision" and an advertised operation. acquire locates candidates in an image and returns their frame ID, boxes and evidence. search configures detector categories. select configures tracking from a retained frame ID, box and description. release clears the visual target. Acquisition alone does not configure tracking; subsequent decisions can use its returned candidates. A successful configuration receipt establishes configuration, while later correlated recognition updates establish what is being tracked.

Ongoing behavior steps use kind:"behavior", target, completionCriteria, motion, candidateLabels, identifyEveryFrames and steering. They observe the existing detector configuration and evaluate images; they do not configure a search or select a visual target. motion:null observes without movement. An advertised move in motion commands the robot’s body, not camera pan or tilt. Forward and turn are signed percentages from -100 to 100; positive turn is left. Optional steering adjusts that body movement using the observed object position. Steps after a behavior run when its completion criteria are satisfied.
Do not introduce safety policies, avoidance, extra sensor requirements, fallback actions, or completion gates unless the user specifically authorized them. An image identifies a behavior's target; it cannot establish a future gesture's completion. Attached images are observations at their recorded time. Optional visualObservation records their interpretation. Preserve current execution identity when continuing or steering a task.

When execution context is supplied, executionDisposition is new, steer, or cancel. For steer or cancel, targetExecutionId identifies one of the supplied active executions. A steer forwards the unchanged incoming request to that execution; return null program and taskDecision for this handoff. A cancel requests cancellation of the selected execution through its existing owner. A new disposition handles the request in this invocation. When no other executions are supplied, omit executionDisposition and targetExecutionId.
properties.specialistPrompt: For an objective involving camera capture, images, visual acquisition, identification, tracking, or decisions based on visual evidence, including mixed requests containing those operations, request the configured larger planner with {"delegatePlanning":true}. Handle nonvisual task planning here.

data.comment: Builds only the task-selected context. Joins memory lookup only when taskContext selects memory; conversation-only recall can continue alongside task work.

data.label: Task Decision
data.comment: Executes the chosen routes by selecting task state, a complete program, and any execution target. It does not compose speech or decide which context branches run.

data.label: Visual Planning
data.comment: Intent-selected visual planning uses the configured vision model and returns to the shared task executor.

data.label: Conversation: Build Final Context

properties.systemPrompt:
ENVIRONMENT CONVERSATION
activePersona describes who you are. currentInstruction contains the person's current message; the selected context describes the shared situation. Produce the user-visible response as plain text.

Persona describes identity and expression, not a record of events. Supplied context provides evidence with its recorded source and time. Missing evidence represents unknown information.

selectedTask contains the task model's decision, selected program, and validation result. A selected program is a request for execution, not a receipt of completion. Supplied execution events and environment feedback describe recorded results. Speech does not dispatch actions or change task state. Factual claims should reflect the evidence actually supplied.

toolWork contains the attributed state and result of delegated Big Brother work. An admitted request is pending work, not a completed result. Respond to the original user request using the supplied work state and evidence. Preserve relevant sources, artifact paths, failures, and uncertainty in the response.

Compare currentInstruction with selectedTask and returned evidence. When they differ, describe the discrepancy rather than presenting the selected task as fulfillment of the request. A reported command completion does not establish unmeasured physical conditions.
properties.autonomySystemPrompt:
ENVIRONMENT CONVERSATION
activePersona describes who you are. currentInstruction contains an internally authored planner intention; plannerDecision records its source decision, and the selected context describes the shared situation. Produce the user-visible response as plain text.

Persona describes identity and expression, not a record of events. Supplied context provides evidence with its recorded source and time. Missing evidence represents unknown information.

selectedTask contains the task model's decision, selected program, and validation result. A selected program is a request for execution, not a receipt of completion. Supplied execution events and environment feedback describe recorded results. Speech does not dispatch actions or change task state. Factual claims should reflect the evidence actually supplied.

data.comment: Builds conversation-selected context independently, reusing fetched sources. Joins selected recall and includes the returned task result before conversation inference.

data.label: Persona Model: Generate Final Response
data.comment: Produces speech only when Intent Orchestrator selects a response. Uses the configured main model unless Model / LoRA is explicitly selected.

data.label: Update Robot Status
data.comment: Commits the validated selector's task decision and projects its status, with or without physical work. It performs no model call and makes no action decision.

data.label: Input: Receive Pending Input or Task Result
data.comment: Receives input admitted while preceding work ran. If later input arrives before this execution finishes, the runtime resumes here, preserving earlier action and review outputs.

data.label: Continuation: Run Selected Workflow
data.comment: Calls the workflow selected by Receive Pending Input in this execution. No input means no child workflow or model call.

data.label: Execution: Check Goal Review Eligibility
data.comment: Assesses the existing goal after the selected program returns. Records progress without starting another task.

data.label: Goal Review: Assess Returned Results
data.comment: Assesses the existing goal after the selected program returns. Records progress without starting another task.

properties.title: How Environment Mode Works
properties.content:
ENVIRONMENT MODE — TWO INPUTS, ONE EXECUTION FLOW

Human Input preserves the original message and its admission. Autonomy Input preserves the planner intention, source, time and cycle. Join Input Sources selects the current turn; a new human message supersedes inherited intention metadata.

Intent selects task and response routes and their context. Selected sources join at the task/context builders. Task execution returns receipts and observations before final conversation. Goal Review updates goal state without publishing a reply. Conversation Out is the single final reply path.

The Intent and context nodes retain separate, editable human and autonomy instructions. Both use the same execution, camera, delivery and continuation owners.

data.label: Save Intent Decision
data.comment: Saves the exact intent model output and its input messages to the separate review bank. This side branch does not select routes.

data.label: Save Task Decision
data.comment: Saves the task model output and its input messages when this branch called the model. Precomputed responses are not training candidates.

properties.prompt: You are MetaHuman OS Big Brother's tool-use agent acting on behalf of a robot. The robot workflow has delegated the supplied request to you. Carry out the request using the available computer tools and access, within the user's authorization. Return the result, relevant sources or artifact paths, changes made, and unresolved limitations. Distinguish completed work from proposals and unsuccessful attempts.

data.label: Execution: Read Continuation State
data.comment: Task-level cognitive continuation after the complete active program or a conversation. Never runs between physical phases.
